representation_paths.memory_component: stored image and audio observations linked to persistent entities

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: The system incrementally stores image and audio observations as entity-linked nodes that can be recovered during iterative graph retrieval.

Semantic memories abstract durable attributes, relationships, and world knowledge from observed clips. For M3-Agent, this specifically supports abstraction of episodes into reusable experience of face and voice features associated with entities.

New face, voice, event, and knowledge entries are incrementally connected around persistent entity identities. For M3-Agent, this specifically supports relinking or reindexing of stored items of face and voice features associated with entities.

Fixed similarity thresholds and match-or-create rules determine whether incoming memories update an existing node or create a new one. For M3-Agent, this specifically supports fixed-rule insertion or replacement of face and voice features associated with entities.

Repeated matches and reactivation update memory weights, which are subsequently used in voting and retrieval. For M3-Agent, this specifically supports evidence-weighted revision of stored belief or confidence of face and voice features associated with entities.

derived.hybrid_relation: Entity nodes bind modality-specific face and voice features to explicit episodic and semantic knowledge.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 9): During inference, the operative memory component (face and voice features associated with entities) changes through abstraction of episodes into reusable experience, relinking or reindexing of stored items, fixed-rule insertion or replacement, evidence-weighted revision of stored belief or confidence; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
